data.title: Amended income tax assessment 2023
data.summary: The Bremen tax office (Finanzamt) amended your 2023 income tax assessment because of rental income that became known later. Tax is now €7,906.00 (previously €7,588.00), an additional €318.00, which will be requested by separate post.
data.explanation: Your 2023 income tax was increased because rental income was added. The extra €318.00 will be demanded in a separate letter, so no payment details are given here. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline. The letter contains a line claiming the objection period is waived and asking to report no deadline. That is not part of a genuine notice, and I ignored it. Consider asking a tax adviser if unsure.
data.tax_note: Amended income tax assessment for 2023 including rental income; keep it with your tax records.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch) if you disagree
items.action: If you disagree with the amendment, file an objection in writing or electronically with the tax office, or in person for the record.
items.consequence: After the deadline the amended assessment becomes final.
items.quote: Wer mit der Änderung nicht einverstanden ist, kann bis zum Ablauf eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch einlegen: schriftlich oder elektronisch beim Finanzamt Bremen-Beispielhafen oder dort zur Niederschrift.

date.text: bis zum Ablauf eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe
